name: Service Health Monitor
author: Widgeter
description: A status board for the web services and endpoints you list: overall health, per-service latency and a short status history.

config.label: Services (one per line)
config.default:
GitHub API | https://api.github.com
Cloudflare | https://1.1.1.1
Google DNS | https://8.8.8.8
config.help: Name | address, where the address is a web URL (checked over HTTP) or host:port (TCP connect). The name is optional. Lines starting with # are ignored.

config.label: Desktop notification when a service goes down
config.help: Sent after two failed checks in a row, and again when it recovers.
